title: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics
hook_text: OpenAI just dropped three brand new science discoveries.
script:
OpenAI just dropped three brand new science discoveries in math, computer science, and physics.
External academic experts called shepherds guided these exact results.
This comes less than a month after OpenAI released hundreds of manuscripts containing math solutions.
Working directly with external researchers helps validate complex automated problem-solving.
Would you trust academic shepherds to supervise complex AI discoveries?
